svg.aria-label: Opposite local quartic coefficients for nearly identical roughness channels
svg.text: Fifth-order-identical roughness, opposite local onset classes
Planar Young–Laplace design; θY = 32° nominal and UNMEASURED
Axial distance in one 300 µm period
Local, not a finite-jump or 3D wetting prediction
Exact: same PSD, extrema and correlations through order five. Sixth order differs.
Numerical: 405 sampled uncertainty cases pass; nearest fold-creation headroom ~38 nm.
